name: Elminster’s Effulgent Spheres

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Six glowing spheres orbit you for 1 hour (one more per slot level above 6). Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder when you cast it. When you take damage of one of those types you can spend a sphere as a Reaction to gain Resistance to that type until the start of your next turn (against an attack you're asked; otherwise it's used only when set to Automatic). As a Bonus Action you can hurl a sphere: a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 feet, 3d6 damage of the chosen type, spending the sphere hit or miss. The spell ends when the last sphere is spent.
